question: For what creative purpose should one meditate on the goddess amid the five yonis?
premises: The goddess stands in the midst of the five yonis.
The meditation is for the single cause of creation.
inference: Meditation on the goddess situated amid the five yonis is prescribed for realizing the single cause of creation.
plain_english: One should meditate on her standing in the midst of the five yonis for the sake of the single cause of creation.
